beats.event: Aging hidalgo Alonso Quijano loses himself in chivalric romances
Renames himself Don Quixote; dubs the nag Rocinante
Names peasant Aldonza his lady Dulcinea del Toboso
Reaches an inn he takes for a castle; is 'knighted' by the innkeeper
Recruits Sancho Panza as squire with the promise of a governorship
Charges the windmills he takes for giants; is hurled from Rocinante
Claims a barber's basin as the legendary Helmet of Mambrino
Frees a chain gang of galley slaves; is stoned and now wanted
Retreats to the Sierra Morena to imitate hermit-knights of romance
The priest and barber trick him homeward inside a cage
Part Two: rides out again, now a celebrity from his printed exploits
Sancho passes off three peasant girls as the enchanted Dulcinea
Duke and Duchess host the pair, staging pranks for their amusement
Sancho takes up his fake island governorship and rules wisely
The Knight of the White Moon defeats Quixote on Barcelona beach
Sentenced to lay down arms for a year and return home
At home he wakes as Alonso Quijano, renounces chivalry, dies
